title: Omega Mag-Bind® Total RNA 96 Kit
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Load samples onto magnetic module
steps.instruction: Place samples in a NEST deepwell plate on the magnetic module (slot 4). Use the two 12‑channel reservoirs for reagents as shown in the Setup. Map each extraction well directly to the corresponding elution well in the PCR plate on the temperature module (slot 1) (e.g., A1→A1, B1→B1, … D2→D2).

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Enter the required protocol parameters in the OT App interface as prompted.

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol
steps.instruction: Download the protocol file and unzip it if it is compressed.

steps.title: Upload custom labware definitions
steps.instruction: In the OT App, go to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and upload the needed .json labware files.

steps.title: Upload protocol script
steps.instruction: Upload the protocol Python file (.py) to the OT App via the Protocol tab.

steps.title: Set up deck layout
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck according to the provided deck map, placing the magnetic module, temperature module, tip racks, reservoirs, and plates in their designated slots.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Run the OT App calibration routine to calibrate the tip rack, all labware, and the pipette; refer to support articles for guidance.

steps.title: Execute protocol
steps.instruction: Press ‘Run’ in the OT App to start the automated RNA extraction protocol.
